housing: Raleigh's rentals are mostly garden-style apartment complexes, townhomes and single-family houses, with many new apartment buildings downtown.

climate: Humid summers mean you should test the air conditioning and look for mold or damp in crawl spaces; photograph trees near the house, since hurricane remnants can bring down limbs.
fact: Many Raleigh leases near NC State start in August to match the academic year.
